description: This file contains the main activity and UI composables for an Android TV streaming application UI, including header, banner, carousel rows, and various card components with image loading via Coil. It defines the overall structure and components of the app's home screen.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity launching the home screen with setContent using Jetpack Compose.

methods.name: HomeScreen
methods.description: Composable function composing the main home screen layout with header, banner, and carousels.

methods.name: HeaderBar
methods.description: Creates a header with logo, navigation pills, and avatar, managing focus and selection states.

methods.name: FocusablePillText
methods.description: A focusable composable displaying a pill-shaped text, highlighting on focus and selection.

methods.name: HeroBanner
methods.description: Displays a large banner image loaded from an absolute file path.

methods.name: CarouselRow
methods.description: Displays a horizontal scrolling row of cards with a title.

methods.name: PosterProgressCard
methods.description: Displays a media poster with focus effects, loading images, and progress indicator.

methods.name: TvChannelCard
methods.description: Displays a TV channel item with overlay, play button, and additional info, with focus effects.

methods.name: StreamXTVTheme
methods.description: Defines a dark Material 3 theme for the app.
